Expert found 3 CRITICALs across rounds, all confirmed in primary text: Guarantee Law chapter 2 (s.21, s.27) applies only to a נושה lending in the ordinary course of business (ss.18-19), not a private landlord; s.25 set-off is non-waivable via 25יד(2), so reasonable repair expenses after the 25ח/9 procedure may be set off; s.22 assignment/sublet (consent in advance and in writing; unreasonable refusal lets the tenant proceed; court may permit despite the lease). Lesson: the previous cycles' corrections were each correct in isolation but encoded a rule without checking the SCOPE section of the statute it came from (Guarantee Law s.18) or the neighbouring sections of the same law (s.22, s.25).
